definitions.explanation: The act of continuing something without interruption.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}を{継続|けいぞく}しますか。
{継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり。
examples.english: Persistence is power. / Continuity is strength.

examples.japanese: {治療|ちりょう}を{継続|けいぞく}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。

notes:
{継続|けいぞく} means continuing or sustaining something over time.

Famous proverb:
- {継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり (Persistence is power / Continuity is strength)

Common collocations:
- {継続|けいぞく}する (to continue)
- {継続|けいぞく}{的|てき}（な/に）(continuous(ly))
- {契約|けいやく}を{継続|けいぞく}する (to continue a contract)
- {継続|けいぞく}{課金|かきん} (recurring billing, subscription)
- {継続|けいぞく}{利用|りよう} (continued use)

Related terms:
- {続|つづ}ける (to continue - verb)
- {持続|じぞく} (maintenance, continuation)
- {連続|れんぞく} (continuation, series)
